messages.subject: Defective seals from Melbourne Sealtech - need advice
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We have a serious problem. Mechanical seals we bought from Melbourne Sealtech for our HP-400 pumps have been failing in the field - dozens of them, well before they should. It has already cost us a fortune in recalls and we've now lost the Pennland Water framework over it.

Can we talk this week about a claim against them? I want to understand our options.

Gavin

Gavin Harrow
Managing Director
Harrow Precision Engineering Limited

messages.subject: RE: Defective seals from Melbourne Sealtech - need advice
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin,

Sorry to hear it - this sounds like a strong claim if the seals are genuinely out of spec. Let's speak Monday. In the meantime please keep every failed seal and all the batch, QC and delivery paperwork; preservation matters.

I'll bring Tom Gallagher in to run the day-to-day. I'll send our engagement letter over so we can get started formally.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
